thread:
Alex K: quick async sync — our Console observability sprint goals: 1) tracing-hook canary + rollout, 2) error-analysis dashboards v1, 3) log/trace retention enforcement. need owners and any blockers now :wave:
Mira Chen: timeline for retention enforcement? is this just config or will it need storage migration? :thinking_face:
Sam Patel: I'll take tracing hooks + canary playbook. plan is to instrument payment svc, api-gateway, jobs, and realtime by Wed. will add an `obs-ready` tag to services. config snippet I'm testing: ```yaml
tracing:
  hooks:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.1
```
Andre Li: heads-up — retention enforcement needs support from storage team for TTL compaction. without that we'll only be able to surface warnings. pinging @storage-team :point_up:
Olivia Gomez: for error-analysis dashboards — need filter UX for customer_id + env and an aggregation by route. also want an approximate cost delta if we extend trace retention to 90d. can we get a mock query and a cost ballpark? :money_with_wings:
Sam Patel: opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4128 — adds hook wiring + canary trigger. needs 1-2 reviews and an infra CI pass. :eyes:
Mira Chen: @Sam can you confirm whether hooking realtime requires any schema changes to trace span format?
Sam Patel: no schema changes. just attach trace metadata: `service_role` and `request_group`. small protobuf bump in client libs, will ship a patch in the PR.
Jules Park: storage side — we can enable TTL compaction, but it'll be a rolling job and requires a short maintenance window. estimate: 2h for initial enforcement, and a data-backfill job if customers need historical retention beyond new TTLs.
Andre Li: who owns scheduling that maintenance window? we need to coordinate with platform releases. also: retention enforcement feature flag would be ideal so we can flip per-tenant.
Alex K: owners so far — tracing hooks: Sam; retention enforcement & scheduling: Jules + Andre; dashboards/error-analysis: Olivia (product) + Mira (eng). Can we commit to dates?
Mira Chen: aiming for retention enforcement gating on storage ready — target 2027-10-05 for soft-enforce (warnings) and 2027-10-12 for hard-enforce (TTL purge), unless storage says otherwise.
Jules Park: tentative OK for those windows, but need final signoff by 2027-10-01 after a quick dry-run. I'll create runbook steps and a rollback plan.
Olivia Gomez: dashboard MVP — I'll drop a mock in Figma by EOD today and post link here. want feedback on the route/grouping and the sample queries. :art:
Sam Patel: can reviewers grab my PR? @Andre @Mira — the canary is harmless (low sample rate) but we need the infra approval to start the canary in prod. deploy-bot should announce once started.
deploy-bot: Canary job started for `tracing-hooks` in us-west-2 (job id: cj-7782). monitor logs at https://ops.redwood/ci/cj-7782 :robot_face:
Andre Li: will review PR tonight. one blocker: if we see storage backpressure during canary, we should auto-scale the trace-ingest workers. adding an autoscale task to the backfill board.
Alex K: great — next actions: Sam -> PR reviews + canary monitor; Jules -> runbook + maintenance window request; Olivia -> Figma + sample queries; Andre -> infra autoscale hookup; Mira -> confirm QA scenarios. I'll collect signoffs in the sprint doc and we can do a short async check Friday. :thumbsup:
Mira Chen: noted, will post QA checklist tomorrow.
Jules Park: will post runbook draft by EOD tomorrow and tag the release calendar.
Sam Patel: thanks — will ping when the canary hits 1k traces/day and when PR is green. :rocket:
